contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 17
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 17 is executable and only Sidebar.css and Sidebar.test.tsx may change; all Topbar, WorkspaceSwitcher, Registry, layout, routing, workspace content, backend, provider, data and runtime paths remain unchanged.
Sidebar navigation items retain exactly 14px typography and Sidebar section headings retain exactly 13px with font weight 600.
Remove the unsafe fixed 24px item height and use compact min-height geometry sufficient for 14px text and complete selected, hover and focus surfaces.
Sidebar items remain vertically centered flex rows and leading 12px icons plus optional trailing 11px Chevron use non-shrinking flex geometry.
The label span uses min-width zero, controlled flex growth and shrink, white-space nowrap, overflow hidden and text-overflow ellipsis so only the text region truncates as a final fallback.
No label wraps to a second line, overlaps an icon or Chevron, escapes the item or Sidebar boundary or becomes vertically clipped.
Tests calculate a positive bounded text budget from the 164px Sidebar, section padding, item padding, 12px leading icon, 7px gaps and optional 11px trailing Chevron for both item forms.
Tests exercise Threat Intelligence, Exposure Management, Executive Summary, Query Workspace and Incident Response and prove overflow remains controlled solely within the label span.
The geometry regression fails for reintroduced fixed 24px height, missing min-width, missing single-line overflow containment or shrinking icons and Chevron.
Sidebar width and min-width remain exactly 164px and the Rework 14 cascade test remains passing without important, specificity, negative-margin, transform or offset workarounds.
Rework 16 WorkspaceSwitcher typography and dropdown geometry remain unchanged and passing.
Rework 15 grouping, CISO ISO naming, selected state, canonical Executive ID and route and real cross-workspace navigation remain unchanged and passing.
Existing PlatformLayout, SOC Dashboard, Explainability and Executive behavior and all earlier preservation gates remain passing.
Focused Sidebar geometry tests, existing Topbar and WorkspaceSwitcher tests, real cross-workspace tests and PlatformLayout, SOC, Explainability and Executive regressions pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact two authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.
Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom across all Sidebar workspaces and the five named long labels.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
